source.name: SportsPro (citing The Athletic)
source.note: Club-wide figure: up to £20m a year if bonuses are met, across men's, women's and academy shirts; the women's share is not stated.

note: Replaces Betano as the club's principal partner. Amnesty International warned the deal is sportswashing. The reported value (up to GBP 20m a year) is for the club-wide deal, recorded on villa-visit-rwanda; it covers the men's, women's and academy shirts, so it is not repeated here.
